expected_edit: add v2 Hello and Heartbeat while keeping unversioned ping

files.body:
The planned v2 work will expand the protocol beyond the current ping-only message, adding richer message types and the corresponding encoding and decoding support while preserving clear handling of unknown input and maintaining a straightforward path for future protocol evolution.

Shipped v2 Hello support with the explicit `v:2|hello:<text>` envelope.
